# Sintec UK Limited

> > Global mechanical and electrical installation contractor specializing in retail, automotive, logistics, and infrastructure projects across the UK, USA, and UAE.

Sintec UK Limited is part of Sintec Holding, delivering large-scale M&E installation services for major brands including Nike, Jaguar Land Rover, Aston Martin, ASOS, Tesco, and Nestlé. The company operates from offices in London, Charlotte (North Carolina), and Dubai, serving clients worldwide with expertise in retail fulfillment centers, automotive facilities, and logistics infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Mechanical & electrical installation
- Retail fulfillment centers
- Automotive facilities
- Logistics infrastructure
- Airport projects
- Global project delivery
- London, Charlotte, Dubai offices
- Sintec US and Sintec MENA divisions
- Client portfolio
- Case studies
- Engineering services
- Project references
- Wholesale distribution
- Micro-fulfillment centers
